questions.question: Who is the first person in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles?
Who was the father of Methuselah?
Which son of Noah is listed first?
Who was the father of Peleg and Joktan?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 1:19 (ESV): "To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg... and the name of his brother Joktan."

questions.question: Who was Abraham’s firstborn son according to the list?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 1:28 (ESV): "The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael."

questions.question: How many sons did Japheth have?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 1:5 (ESV): "The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras." (Count is 7)

questions.question: Which people group descended from Mizraim?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 1:11-12 (ESV): "Mizraim fathered... the Casluhim (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorim."

questions.question: Who was the first of the mighty men on earth, son of Cush?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 1:10 (ESV): "Cush fathered Nimrod. He was the first on earth to be a mighty man."

questions.question: Who were the kings who reigned in Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 1:43-45 (ESV): "...Bela the son of Beor... Jobab the son of Zerah... Husham of the land of the Temanites..."

questions.question: To whom does the text attribute the division of the earth?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 1:19 (ESV): "...the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided..."

questions.question: Who was the sister of Lotan?
Which of these is NOT listed as a son of Seir?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 1:38 (ESV): "The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan."

questions.question: What was the name of the city of King Hadad?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 1:50 (ESV): "...Hadad reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pai..."

questions.question: Who were the sons of Midian?
options: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah
questions.correctAnswer: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 1:33 (ESV): "The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah..."

questions.question: Who ruled in Edom after the death of Hadad?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 1:51 (ESV): "And Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chiefs Timna, Aliah, Jetheth..."
